function.arguments: {"answer": "The email campaign did not improve conversion compared to paid search; in fact, it reduced conversion rates across all customer segments, with a weighted average difference of -0.128 (email minus paid_search).", "value": -0.128, "method": "The data dictionary confirms that the email campaign was deliberately targeted at high-value customers (e.g., loyal customers), which creates a confounding bias: the email group has a higher proportion of loyal customers, who naturally have higher conversion rates. To isolate the true campaign effect, we computed conversion rates within each customer segment and found that email had lower conversion rates than paid_search in all segments: loyal (-0.180), returning (-0.062), and new (-0.157).
